topic: Reporting Bathroom Mold and Asking for Removal

script.title: THE WET SOCKS SMELL
script.scene_zh: 管理處辦公室 · 報修黴菌
script.story_hook: A wall is hiding something, and photos will prove it.
script.intro_zh: 牆壁藏著問題，而照片會證明一切。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today a tenant reports a mold problem. Listen for describing smells and repairs.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天要聽住戶報修浴室黴菌。留意描述氣味與維修的說法。
script.outro: That's a repair booked in one honest conversation. Listen again and reuse the moves.
script.outro_zh: 一趟坦誠的對話，就搞定了一次維修。再聽一遍，把技巧學起來。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat each line, nice and slow.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們現在逐句跟讀，慢慢地、清楚地。
script.char_a_description: a warm-looking woman in her forties with shoulder-length black hair streaked with early gray, small gold stud earrings, a burgundy fleece jacket over a beige turtleneck, and a curvy build
script.char_b_description: a laid-back young man in his late twenties with sandy hair tied in a loose low bun, freckles across his nose, an olive green work shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki shorts, and a lanky build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm from unit eight. It's about my bathroom.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm fɹəm ˈjunɪt eɪt ɪts əˈbaʊt maɪ ˈbæθˌɹum/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我是八號房的住戶，為了浴室的事來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, what's happening with the bathroom?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ wʌts ˈhæpənɪŋ wɪð ðə ˈbæθˌɹum/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，浴室出什麼事了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, there's black mold behind the shower curtain.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðɛɹz blæk moʊld bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈʃaʊɚ ˈkɜɹtn/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，浴簾後面的牆上有黑色的黴菌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mold? Okay, how long has it been there?
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊld oʊkeɪ haʊ lɔŋ hæz ɪt bɪn ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 黴菌？好，它長在那裡多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three weeks, maybe more, it grew fast overnight.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi wikz ˈmeɪbi mɔɹ ɪt ɡɹu fæst ˌoʊvɚˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 三週，或更久，一夜之間就長出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, did you try wiping it with anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm dɪd ju traɪ ˈwaɪpɪŋ ɪt wɪð ˈɛnɪˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，你有試過擦掉它嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did, twice, but it comes right back.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd twaɪs bʌt ɪt kʌmz ɹaɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 擦過兩次，可是它馬上又回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, that changes things, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ ðæt ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz θɪŋz ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 這樣啊，老實說，那就不一樣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It changes? I hoped wiping was the fix.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz aɪ hoʊpt ˈwaɪpɪŋ wəz ðə fɪks/
dialogue.zh: 不一樣？我還以為擦擦就能搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, wipe-only means moisture is hiding somewhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ waɪp ˈoʊnli minz ˈmɔɪstʃɚ ɪz ˈhaɪdɪŋ ˈsʌmˌwɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 只擦沒用，代表潮氣藏在某個地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly what I thought, and I hate guessing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt aɪ θɑt ænd aɪ heɪt ˈɡɛsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我也這樣想，我最討厭猜來猜去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair. Can you send me photos first?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ kæn ju sɛnd mi ˈfoʊtoʊz fɚst/
dialogue.zh: 了解。可以先傳幾張照片給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photos, yes, I took six yesterday already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊz jɛs aɪ tʊk sɪks ˈjɛstɚˌdeɪ ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 照片有的，昨天我已經拍了六張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six! You're the best tenant ever, really.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks jʊɹ ðə bɛst ˈtɛnənt ˈɛvɚ ˈɹɪli/
dialogue.zh: 六張！你真是史上最棒的住戶，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flattery won't fix my wall, Trevor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈflæɾəɹi woʊnt fɪks maɪ wɑl ˈtɹɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 誇讚修不好我的牆，Trevor。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, true. Text them to the office number, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tɹu tɛkst ðɛm tə ðə ˈɔfɪs ˈnʌmbɚ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，說得也是。請傳簡訊到辦公室的號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sent. Um, does the smell bother you too?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnt ʌm dʌz ðə smɛl ˈbɑðɚ ju tu/
dialogue.zh: 傳了。嗯，那個氣味會不會也困擾你？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, there's a smell? Describe it for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðɛɹz ə smɛl dɪˈskɹaɪb ɪt fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 等等，還有味道？形容給我聽聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like wet socks left in a gym bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk wɛt sɑks lɛft ɪn ə dʒɪm bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 像在運動包裡留下的濕襪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ugh, yeah, that smell gets checked, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌɡ jɛ ðæt smɛl ɡɛts tʃɛkt tɹʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 噁，這種味道一定要查，相信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Musty? My son's cough has been worse lately.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌsti maɪ sʌnz kɔf hæz bɪn wɚs ˈleɪtli/
dialogue.zh: 發黴味吧？我兒子的咳嗽最近也變嚴重了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that's important, we'll move it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts ɪmˈpɔɹtənt wil muv ɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那就嚴重了，我們會優先處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move it up? What does that mean exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ɪt ʌp wʌt dʌz ðæt min ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 優先處理？確切地說是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same-week repair, not the usual three weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm wiːk ɹɪˈpɛɹ nɑt ðə ˈjuʒəwəl θɹi wiːks/
dialogue.zh: 這一週就修，不用排三個星期的隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three weeks?! I didn't know there was a queue.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi wiːks aɪ dɪdnt noʊ ðɛɹ wəz ə kju/
dialogue.zh: 三個星期？！我不知道還要排隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's always a queue, health comes first though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz ˈɔlweɪz ə kju hɛlθ kʌmz fɚst ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 永遠都有隊，不過健康的事排最前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Should I bring the cough too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ʃʊd aɪ brɪŋ ðə kɔf tu/
dialogue.zh: 好。那我要不要把咳嗽也帶來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Just the doctor's note, if you have one.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ dʒʌst ðə ˈdɑktɚz noʊt ɪf ju hæv wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 哈！帶醫生的證明就好，如果有的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do, it says allergies worse with mold.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du ɪt sɛz əˈlɜɹdʒiz wɚs wɪð moʊld/
dialogue.zh: 有的，上面寫著過敏遇到黴菌會加重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that note jumps the whole queue.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ðæt noʊt dʒʌmps ðə hoʊl kju/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那張證明能讓你直接排最前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amazing. Now, what will the repair involve?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈmeɪzɪŋ naʊ wʌt wɪl ðə ɹɪˈpɛɹ ɪnˈvɑlv/
dialogue.zh: 太神了。那這次維修會做哪些事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, our guy opens the wall and checks the pipe.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚst ɑɹ ɡaɪ ˈoʊpənz ðə wɑl ænd tʃɛks ðə paɪp/
dialogue.zh: 先請師傅打開牆面，檢查裡面的水管。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pipe? You think it's leaking inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə paɪp ju θɪŋk ɪts ˈlikɪŋ ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 水管？你覺得裡面在漏？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Likely, the hot pipe sweats in summer, common.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlaɪkli ðə hɑt paɪp swɛts ɪn ˈsʌmɚ ˈkɑmən/
dialogue.zh: 很可能，熱水管夏天會出汗，很常見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will they fix the fan too? It's lazy.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðeɪ fɪks ðə fæn tu ɪts ˈleɪzi/
dialogue.zh: 排氣扇也會修嗎？它懶得可憐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, fan replacement is part of the job.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fæn ɹɪˈpleɪsmənt ɪz pɑɹt əv ðə dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 會，換新排氣扇是這單的一部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Um, when can they come in?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ʌm wɛn kæn ðeɪ kʌm ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。嗯，他們什麼時候能進門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesday, between nine and five, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzˌdeɪ bɪˈtwin naɪn ænd faɪv ɪz ðæt oʊkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 星期二，九點到五點之間，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuesday I work, can they use a key?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuzˌdeɪ aɪ wɜɹk kæn ðeɪ juz ə ki/
dialogue.zh: 星期二我要上班，他們可以用鑰匙進嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can, entry log, two witnesses, standard.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn ˈɛntɹi lɑɡ tu ˈwɪtnəssəz ˈstændərd/
dialogue.zh: 可以，登記進出、兩人見證，標準流程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two witnesses? That feels like a movie.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈwɪtnəssəz ðæt filz laɪk ə ˈmuvi/
dialogue.zh: 兩人見證？感覺像電影情節。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Policy protects you too, see? We take it seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑləsi pɹəˈtɛkts ju tu si wi teɪk ɪt ˈsɪɹiəsli/
dialogue.zh: 規定也保護你，你瞧，我們是認真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair point. My plants will be watered, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ pɔɪnt maɪ plænts wɪl bi ˈwɔɾɚd ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 說得也是。我的植物會有人澆水，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Plants included, that's in the form, line four.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ plænts ɪnˈkludɪd ðæts ɪn ðə fɔɹm laɪn fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！植物也包，表格第四行就寫著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read line four, water the ferns, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹid laɪn fɔɹ ˈwɔɾɚ ðə fɜɹnz dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 讀第四行：澆蕨類，完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, one thing I must ask: no paint-over fixes.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wʌn θɪŋ aɪ mʌst æsk noʊ peɪnt ˈoʊvɚ ˈfɪksəz/
dialogue.zh: 現在有件事我必須先講：不接受直接油漆蓋過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paint-over? Is that what others do?
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪnt ˈoʊvɚ ɪz ðæt wʌt ˈʌðərz du/
dialogue.zh: 油漆蓋過去？別人也會這樣要求嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some tenants ask me to just paint over it.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ˈtɛnənts æsk mi tə dʒʌst peɪnt ˈoʊvɚ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有些住戶叫我直接油漆蓋一蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yuck, hide the mold, feel fancy for a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʌk haɪd ðə moʊld fil ˈfænsi fɚ ə mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 噁，把黴菌藏起來，優雅一個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, it returns darker, so we refuse nicely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ɪt ɹɪˈtɜɹnz ˈdɑɹkɚ soʊ wi ɹɪˈfjuz ˈnaɪsli/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，之後長得更黑，所以我們會好好拒絕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You won't need to refuse me, I promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju woʊnt nid tə ɹɪˈfjuz mi aɪ ˈpɑɹməs/
dialogue.zh: 你不用拒絕我，我保證不那樣做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Photos received, you're booked for Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈfoʊtoʊz ɹɪˈsivd jʊɹ bʊkt fɚ ˈtuzˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好。照片收到了，你排進星期二了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was smooth, I almost prepared a speech.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wəz smuːθ aɪ ˈɔlmoʊst pɹɪˈpɛrd ə spitʃ/
dialogue.zh: 真順利，我差點準備好一篇演說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save it for the wall, they like applause too.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ɪt fɚ ðə wɑl ðeɪ laɪk əˈplɔz tu/
dialogue.zh: 留給牆壁吧，它們也喜歡掌聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Can I at least bring cookies for the crew?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ kæn aɪ æt list bɹɪŋ ˈkʊkiz fɚ ðə kɹu/
dialogue.zh: 哈！至少我可以帶餅乾慰勞師傅嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cookies are not policy, but I am reachable.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʊkiz ɑɹ nɑt ˈpɑləsi bʌt aɪ æm ˈɹitʃəbl/
dialogue.zh: 餅乾不在規定裡，但我這人很好約。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted, two chocolate chip, entry Tuesday nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtəd tu ˈtʃɑklət tʃɪp ˈɛntɹi ˈtuzˌdeɪ naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，兩顆巧克力豆餅乾，星期二九點進場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten, make it ten, the morning is brutal.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn meɪk ɪt tɛn ðə ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ɪz ˈbɹuɾəl/
dialogue.zh: 十點，改成十點，早上太殘酷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten it is. Thanks for taking this seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ɪt ɪz θæŋks fɚ ˈteɪkɪŋ ðɪs ˈsɪɹiəsli/
dialogue.zh: 就十點。謝謝你把這件事認真對待。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always. Text me if the cough gets worse.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlweɪz tɛkst mi ɪf ðə kɔf ɡɛts wɚs/
dialogue.zh: 應該的。咳嗽加重的話，傳訊息給我。

script.youtube_title: 【浴室發黴怎麼辦🛁】「誇讚修不好我的牆」住戶報修黴菌全對話📸🎧｜照片・氣味・醫生證明｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Reporting Bathroom Mold
script.youtube_title_en: "Flattery Won't Fix My Wall" — Reporting Bathroom Mold and Booking a Repair
script.youtube_description:
「誇讚修不好我的牆」——浴室牆上長了黑黴，用英文該怎麼報修，才能一週內叫到師傅？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在管理處的報修櫃台。

你會聽到：報修的開場句；描述黴菌位置、生長速度與「濕襪子」味的說法；傳照片、帶醫生證明、插隊規則的完整流程；水管滲漏、排氣扇更換的維修細節；還有師傅進門的見證制度，以及怎麼婉拒「油漆蓋一蓋」的暫時做法。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人報修時的真實語感：um、well、so、ha、ugh。聽完你就會用：there's black mold、send me photos、same-week repair、no paint-over fixes。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先記住，腦袋自然就跟上。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Flattery won't fix my wall" — how do you report bathroom mold in English and actually get a same-week repair? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at the property office service desk.

You will hear: opening a maintenance request, describing where the mold is and how fast it grew, the wet-socks smell compared out loud, sending photos, using a doctor's note to jump the repair queue, and the policy details: entry logs, two witnesses, fan replacement, and why paint-over fixes are politely refused.

Everything stays in A2-level words with real repair-counter texture: um, well, so, ha, ugh. By the end you'll own phrases like there's black mold, send me photos, and same-week repair.

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

📌 影片簡介：
浴室牆角冒出黑黴，擦掉又長回來，還帶著一股濕襪子的味道，這種事該怎樣用英文報修？醫生證明真的有插隊效果嗎？

這一集帶大家走進管理處櫃台，聽住戶與 property manager 從一張照片一路聊到星期二的維修隊，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🛁 報修開場：Well, there's black mold behind the shower curtain.
📸 描述氣味：Like wet socks left in a gym bag.
🩺 證明效力：Perfect, that note jumps the whole queue.
🚫 拒絕偷工：Yuck, hide the mold, feel fancy for a month.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so、ugh 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這趟報修走完，下次家裡有任何問題，你也能把話說得又清楚又客氣。

祝你家的牆從此乾爽，連空氣都是香的。
